title: DataAsset
description: PACK-09, ADR-040. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.DataAsset). One Data Catalog entry: a governed store or dataset in one organization, tied to the record class and retention policy that govern it. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
